get.description: The attention box for the signed-in user, as the Today page builds it (only employees with an HR row).
The items of one Анхаарах group past the first GROUP_LIMIT, or a page of a gap group with `all=1`.

post.description: "Мэдлээ" / "Дахин харуулах" on one Анхаарах item or a whole group; answers with the box.
«Хийгдсэн» on a checklist task the user owns (404 when the user may not tick it, 409 when it is refused).

get.description: The company figures page (403 without the employee-list right, as company_page).

post.description:
Hire a new employee from the add form, the same hire as the Django page. `values` is a JSON object of HTML name
-> string (every box, a checkbox as "on" or absent); `candidate` and `submission` are the hidden values the form
posts back. A refused or invalid form answers 200 with ok false and nothing is written. 403 without the manage
right, 400 for malformed values, 401 without a login.

get.description:
The employee already under this register number, if the user may see them (the live check on the hire page).
The number is normalised the way the save normalises it; an empty one looks nobody up.

The district options of the city, as the hire page's district select shows them. No or an unknown city has no
district, so the list is empty.

The hire form's layout, fields and gating. `candidate` and `submission` are the recruitment candidate and the
self-form HR hires from; the other query values prefill the forms (the recruitment «Ажилд авах» link). A bad or
foreign id is ignored. 403 without the manage right.

`{number, date}` for the «Санал болгох» button: the next number of the year of `date` (else today) and the date
to use when the form's date is still empty. A bad or empty date means today.
The header, rail and rights of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise).

One batch of the «Түүх» drawer for an employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise), as activity_more:
50 entries from `offset` (a junk offset is 0), the day heading of the entry above, and the next offset.

The cancel pop-up. 404 when the event is not cancellable (applied, cancelled) or is not the employee's; 403
without the right to cancel it.

post.description:
Cancel the event. A refused form (no reason, a signed order without its cancel order number) answers 200 with
ok false and changes nothing.

Record the change. A refused or invalid form answers 200 with ok false and nothing is written; on success the
MACS number-clash note is kept for the next employee page. For a refused save with an unreal date, the hidden
`prev_effective` must travel inside `values` (the key "prev_effective"), as the page posts it, so the response keeps
the last real date.

The event form's state for the values typed so far. 404 for an unknown type or an employee outside the user's
scope, 403 without the right to record this type. Nothing is written.
Correct one job row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one job row (403 without the manage right or for a scheduled row).

post.description:
Create the employee's login and answer its temporary password once (no-store). An invalid username is a 400
with field_errors["username"]; a refused creation (a second login, a taken name) is a 400 with form_errors.
Add a note to the employee's activity log (a manager's right; 404 outside the user's scope, 403 without it).

get.description:
The cancel pop-up of a registered order with no change behind it (the reason). 404 for a change's order, a
signed or pending one; 403 without the manage right.

post.description:
Cancel the order with the posted reason. A missing reason answers 200 with ok false on the `reason` field; a
service refusal answers 200 with ok false as a form error. Nothing is written then.

get.description: The whole order pop-up. Anyone who may see the employee may open it; the buttons follow the user's rights.
The order filled from its Word template, as .docx (a draft to print and sign). 403 without the manage right.
The same order as a PDF. 403 without the manage right; a cancelled order is 404.

The edit pop-up with the saved values (or a suggested number). 404 for a signed or cancelled order; 403 without
the manage right.

post.description:
Save the edit. A refused form answers 200 with ok false and changes nothing; a saved order keeps the MACS
number-clash note for the next employee page.

get.description: The signed scan of the order. Hire and rehire scans need the salary right (403 without it).

Who created, registered, edited, signed or cancelled this order, and when. Needs only the right to see the
employee (no manage right).

The signing pop-up's data: the title with the order's number, and whether the user has a saved signature. 403
without the signing switch or for a hire order whose salary the user may not see; 404 when not registered.

post.description:
Sign the registered order (saved or drawn). A refusal that writes nothing answers 200 with ok false and the
messages; the signing is not wrapped in a transaction here (the service makes its own).

get.description: The signature picture of a signed order. Anyone who may see the employee may see it; not logged.
The upload pop-up: one file box (multipart). 403 without the manage right.

post.description:
Attach the signed scan. A missing, wrong or too big file, or an order that is not registered, answers 200 with
ok false and the message on the form; nothing is attached then. Uploads keep no MACS note.

get.description:
The header, work and bank fields and the salary fields of one employee the user may see, with their stored
values (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the manage or the salary right).

The personal tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the personal right):
the topic groups with their chips, the four field sections, and the personal lists.

post.description:
Save one section of the personal tab (the same save as the Django section form). Business outcomes answer
200 with the result; an unknown section is 404, a user without the manage and personal rights is 403.
Add one row of a personal list. A refused form answers 200 with ok false; an unknown list is 404.

get.description:
The pop-up of one personal-list row: an add form (no key) or the edit form of the row `key`. An address takes
city, district and street as presets so the district choices follow the city (the Django pop-up's rule).

post.description:
Change one row of a personal list if it still matches the loaded values posted back (a changed row answers
200 with ok false and the message in form_errors). Missing loaded values: 400, nothing written; unknown row: 404.
Delete one row of a personal list, on the loaded values posted back (same rules as the edit).

get.description:
The Salary tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the salary right):
today's pay, the pay history rows and the «Банк, даатгал» block.

post.description: Set the first salary and write its activity entry. A refused form answers 200 with ok false.

get.description:
The pop-up to set the first salary (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the salary right or once a salary
exists).

post.description: Correct one salary row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one salary row (403 for a scheduled row; 404 for another employee's row).

post.description:
Save what the user may change on the employee page. `values_json` is a JSON object of HTML name -> string
(the fields, `loaded`, `si-loaded` and any `resolve-<name>`). Business outcomes answer 200 with the result.

Tick or untick one setup item (Бүрдүүлэлт) while the employee's checklist is open. 403 without the manage right
or once the checklist is closed; a system item answers 400.

get.description:
The Work tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise): job, contract, MACS fields, the
history, the waiting changes, the other orders, the leave block and the checklist panels.
The My page of the signed-in user (its own record only; 404 without an employee record).

post.description: «Мэдлээ» on one result notice. Only a notice of the user's own request can be dismissed (404 otherwise).
«Буцаах»: the user takes back their own waiting request. Someone else's request is 404; a refused change 409.

get.description: The signed-in user's own saved signature picture (only ever their own; 404 when none). Not logged.

post.description: Delete the user's own saved signature. Answers ok; the page refreshes its own query.

get.description: Every matching row, grouped by department, as the print page draws it. Writes one export log line.

post.description:
The ticked orders as one PDF, one order per page. Form-encoded `ids` so a plain form can post them; each
printed order is logged like a single download.
Start the ticked orders' PDF as a background job (11 orders or more); the page polls the job's status.

get.description: The job's PDF once it is ready. 404 until then, and for another user's or an unknown job.
The job's state. Only the user who started it may read it (404 otherwise, and for an unknown token).

post.description:
HR rejects a submitted self-form for good; the reason is kept on the invitation. A blank reason or a form that
is not waiting for HR is refused with ok false. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.

HR sends a submitted self-form back to the employee with a note. A blank note or a form that is not waiting for
HR is refused with ok false and nothing is written. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.

get.description: The names of people away on one day of the Today strip (`?day=YYYY-MM-DD`, inside the 14-day window).
The names of people who joined in the last 30 days (the hires line of «Ойрын 30 хоног»).
The birthdays or the work anniversaries in the next 30 days (`?kind=birthday|anniversary`).
The report setups that say what is coming up, with their counts (empty without reports.view_reports).
